title: YouTube Channel with FlashData
description: Enter your Key and required handle input. Start performs one YouTube Channel request using your FlashData Credits.

flashdataApiKey.title: FlashData API key
flashdataApiKey.description: Your own FlashData API key with YouTube Channel permission. Encrypted; no shared key is provided.

handle.title: Handle
handle.description: YouTube channel handle, such as @example. Not a URL or channel ID.

video_limit.title: Video Limit
video_limit.description: Maximum recent videos to request; not the channel total.
